<h1 id="pygments">pygments - 强大的代码高亮和格式化工具</h1>
<h2 id="pygments-1">一、什么是pygments？</h2>
<p><strong>pygments</strong> 是一个用于语法高亮和格式化各种编程语言代码的 Python 库。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>将代码渲染成带有颜色和样式的HTML、LaTeX、RTF等格式。</li>
<li>支持数百种编程语言和标记语言。</li>
<li>提供简单的API，易于集成到你的应用程序中。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="section">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>pygments</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Web应用</strong>: 在博客、论坛或文档网站中显示高亮的源代码。</li>
<li><strong>文档生成</strong>: 为技术文档、报告或书籍自动生成带高亮的代码示例。</li>
<li><strong>静态网站生成器</strong>: Jekyll、Sphinx等工具使用Pygments来高亮代码块。</li>
<li><strong>代码编辑器或IDE</strong>: 作为后端服务，为用户输入提供语法高亮。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="section-1">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install pygments

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install pygments -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="section-2">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>将一段Python代码高亮显示为HTML格式。</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from pygments import highlight
from pygments.lexers import PythonLexer
from pygments.formatters import HtmlFormatter

# 要高亮显示的Python代码
code_to_highlight = """
def greet(name):
    # 这是一个简单的Python函数
    if name:
        return f"Hello, {name}!"
    else:
        return "Hello, World!"

print(greet("Alice"))
"""

# 创建一个Python词法分析器
lexer = PythonLexer()

# 创建一个HTML格式化器
formatter = HtmlFormatter(full=True, style='colorful') # full=True 生成完整HTML文档，style='colorful' 设置高亮样式

# 使用Pygments进行高亮
highlighted_html = highlight(code_to_highlight, lexer, formatter)

# 打印高亮后的HTML代码（这可以在浏览器中查看）
print(highlighted_html[:500]) # 只打印前500个字符，避免输出过长

# 检查是否成功生成了HTML
if "&lt;html&gt;" in highlighted_html:
    print("\n代码成功高亮并包含预期内容。")
else:
    print("\n代码高亮或内容检查失败。")
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="http://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=from%20pygments%20import%20highlight%0Afrom%20pygments.lexers%20import%20PythonLexer%0Afrom%20pygments.formatters%20import%20HtmlFormatter%0A%0A%23%20%E8%A6%81%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E7%9A%84Python%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%0Acode_to_highlight%20%3D%20%22%22%22%0Adef%20greet%28name%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E8%BF%99%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E7%AE%80%E5%8D%95%E7%9A%84Python%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%0A%20%20%20%20if%20name%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20f%22Hello%2C%20%7Bname%7D!%22%0A%20%20%20%20else%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20%22Hello%2C%20World!%22%0A%0Aprint%28greet%28%22Alice%22%29%29%0A%22%22%22%0A%0A%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AAPython%E8%AF%8D%E6%B3%95%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90%E5%99%A8%0Alexer%20%3D%20PythonLexer%28%29%0A%0A%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AAHTML%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F%E5%8C%96%E5%99%A8%0Aformatter%20%3D%20HtmlFormatter%28full%3DTrue%2C%20style%3D%27colorful%27%29%20%23%20full%3DTrue%20%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4HTML%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%EF%BC%8Cstyle%3D%27colorful%27%20%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%E6%A0%B7%E5%BC%8F%0A%0A%23%20%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8Pygments%E8%BF%9B%E8%A1%8C%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%0Ahighlighted_html%20%3D%20highlight%28code_to_highlight%2C%20lexer%2C%20formatter%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%E5%90%8E%E7%9A%84HTML%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%EF%BC%88%E8%BF%99%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E5%9C%A8%E6%B5%8F%E8%A7%88%E5%99%A8%E4%B8%AD%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B%EF%BC%89%0Aprint%28highlighted_html%5B%3A500%5D%29%20%23%20%E5%8F%AA%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E5%89%8D500%E4%B8%AA%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%EF%BC%8C%E9%81%BF%E5%85%8D%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E8%BF%87%E9%95%BF%0A%0A%23%20%E6%A3%80%E6%9F%A5%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E4%BA%86HTML%0Aif%20%22%3Chtml%3E%22%20in%20highlighted_html%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22%5Cn%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%E5%B9%B6%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%E9%A2%84%E6%9C%9F%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%E3%80%82%22%29%0Aelse%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22%5Cn%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E9%AB%98%E4%BA%AE%E6%88%96%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%E6%A3%80%E6%9F%A5%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%E3%80%82%22%29" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行这段代码，结果如下：</p>
